regulations.title: FDA 21 CFR Part 50 - Protection of Human Subjects
regulations.summary: Establishes standards for informed consent and safeguards the rights, safety, and welfare of subjects in clinical investigations regulated by the FDA.
regulations.applicability: Clinical investigations involving FDA-regulated products (drugs, biologics, medical devices)

regulations.title: FDA 21 CFR Part 56 - Institutional Review Boards
regulations.summary: Establishes requirements for the organization, composition, function, and operation of Institutional Review Boards that review clinical investigations.

regulations.title: Common Rule - 45 CFR Part 46
regulations.summary: Federal policy for the protection of human subjects in research, adopted by multiple federal departments and agencies.
regulations.applicability: Research conducted, supported, or regulated by Common Rule departments and agencies

regulations.title: ICH E6(R2) Good Clinical Practice
regulations.summary: International ethical and scientific quality standard for designing, conducting, recording, and reporting trials that involve human subjects.
keyRequirements: Quality and integrity of trial data
regulations.applicability: Clinical trials intended for regulatory submission to ICH member countries

regulations.title: Declaration of Helsinki
regulations.summary: Statement of ethical principles for medical research involving human subjects, including research on identifiable human material and data.
regulations.applicability: Physicians and other participants in medical research involving human subjects

regulations.title: HIPAA Privacy Rule - 45 CFR Parts 160 and 164
regulations.authority: Department of Health and Human Services (HHS)
regulations.summary: National standards to protect individuals' medical records and other individually identifiable health information.
keyRequirements: Individual rights to access and control PHI
regulations.applicability: Covered entities and business associates handling PHI in research

regulations.title: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)
regulations.summary: Regulation on data protection and privacy for individuals within the European Union and European Economic Area.
keyRequirements: Data subject rights (access, rectification, erasure, portability)
Privacy by design and by default
regulations.applicability: Organizations processing personal data of EU residents, including research activities

topics.title: Informed Consent
topics.description: Requirements and best practices for obtaining and documenting informed consent from research participants.

topics.title: IRB Review Process
topics.description: Institutional Review Board requirements, composition, functions, and review procedures.

topics.title: Vulnerable Populations
topics.description: Additional protections and considerations for vulnerable research participants.

topics.title: Data Privacy and Security
topics.description: Requirements for protecting participant privacy and securing research data.

topics.title: Adverse Event Reporting
topics.description: Requirements for monitoring, documenting, and reporting adverse events in research.

topics.title: Clinical Trial Requirements
topics.description: Standards and requirements for conducting clinical trials.
